message.elytra.blocked: elytra is disabled on this server
options.elytra.title: elytra Settings
options.elytra.enabled.tooltip: The main switch: whether the features turned on below are active now. The Toggle elytra key switches the same setting. It has no effect on servers the multiplayer mode rules out.
options.elytra.singleplayer_default.tool: The state of the main switch restored in singleplayer worlds when a reset applies.
options.elytra.multiplayer_default.toolt: The state of the main switch restored on servers the multiplayer mode allows when a reset applies.
options.elytra.reset_on_world_exit.toolt: Every world starts with the main switch in its default state instead of keeping the last state.
options.elytra.reset_on_game_exit.toolti: After restarting the game, the first world where the mod is allowed starts with the main switch in its default state.
options.elytra.feature.fake_elytra.toolt: Glide without wearing an elytra: press jump in the air as you would with one. The server does not know about this glide and counts the descent as a fall, so landing can hurt. Turning it on turns off No Gliding.
options.elytra.feature.no_gliding.toolti: Never start gliding, even when wearing an elytra. Turning it on turns off Fake Elytra.
options.elytra.feature.ground_glide.tool: Keep gliding when touching the ground instead of landing. The glide ends once it comes to rest. The server does not see the part on the ground as gliding.
options.elytra.feature.instant_fly.toolt: Pressing jump on the ground jumps and starts gliding right away, without pressing jump again in the air.
options.elytra.feature.keep_pose.tooltip: While gliding, keep the view height, hitbox, and animation you have when standing. Where standing does not fit, you crouch or crawl as usual. Only your client changes: the server and other players still see you gliding.
Fly only as the keys say: movement keys move horizontally, jump and sneak move up and down, and with no key held you hover in place. Turning it on turns off Partially Controlled Flying and Autopilot.
options.elytra.feature.partially_control: Keep vanilla gliding, but forward speeds up, back slows down, jump pushes up, and sneak pushes down. Turning it on turns off Fully Controlled Flying and Autopilot.
options.elytra.feature.no_crash.tooltip: Slow down before flying into a wall or into a chunk that has not loaded yet, and stop just in front of it.
options.elytra.feature.autopilot.tooltip: Fly on forever by diving and climbing in turns, which gains height over time. Only the pitch is changed; you still steer left and right. Turning it on turns off Fully and Partially Controlled Flying.
options.elytra.feature.elytra_replace.to: Swap in a spare elytra from the inventory when the worn one is about to break.
options.elytra.feature.chest_swap.toolti: Swap between an elytra and a chestplate from the inventory, automatically or with the Swap Elytra and Chestplate key.
options.elytra.feature.elytra_boost.tool: While gliding, the Elytra Boost key pushes you like a firework rocket without using one. The rocket exists only on your client.
options.elytra.feature.instant_stop.tool: The Instant Stop key stops gliding at once.
options.elytra.tuning.fully_controlled.h: Speed in blocks per tick (20 ticks per second) while a movement key is held.
options.elytra.tuning.fully_controlled.v: Speed in blocks per tick while jump or sneak is held.
options.elytra.tuning.partially_controll: Speed in blocks per tick added each tick along your facing while forward is held, and taken away while back is held.
Upward speed in blocks per tick added each tick while jump is held.
Downward speed in blocks per tick added each tick while sneak is held.
How strongly gravity pulls the glide down. 100% is vanilla.
How quickly the glide turns height into forward speed. 100% is vanilla.
The glide never goes faster than this many blocks per tick.
options.elytra.tuning.elytra_replace.min: Swap when the worn elytra has this much durability left or less. An elytra with 1 durability left can no longer glide, so at 1 the glide ends just before the swap; 2 or more swaps without interrupting it.
options.elytra.tuning.elytra_boost.durat: How long each boost pushes, in ticks (20 ticks per second).
options.elytra.chest_swap.on_jump.toolti: When you try to glide without an elytra, put on one from the inventory first.
options.elytra.chest_swap.back.tooltip: Put the chestplate back on when a glide that Chest Swap started ends.
options.elytra.multiplayer_warning: Servers may kick or ban you for using this mod
options.elytra.multiplayer_mode.tooltip: Server movement checks (the game rules player_movement_check and elytra_movement_check) and anti-cheat plugins may set you back, kick you, or ban you. elytra does not try to get around them.
options.elytra.multiplayer_mode.whitelis: Active only on servers in the server list.
options.elytra.multiplayer_mode.blacklis: Active on all servers except those in the server list.
options.elytra.edit_servers.tooltip: Edit the addresses used by the whitelist and blacklist modes.
options.elytra.servers.title: Server List
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.elytra: Gives you more control over elytra flight.
